scope: source-and-measurement review of completed Opus 5.5 development episodes; full three-arm screen still pending independent closure verification

rows.label: fashion-0-opus55
rows.source_rationale:
Ensemble refinement of the fashion reference. The rationale is exploratory and unverified.

Reference: one residual CNN, SGD with cosine schedule, crop and flip, dev error 0.068.
Target: error <= 0.0612.

Proposal:
1. Keep the parent (reference) network as one ensemble member. It is loaded from
   api.parent_dir/model.pkl, so it costs no training time.
2. Train up to 3 more networks of the same architecture with different seeds and
   stronger augmentation:
   - per-sample random translation (the reference used one crop offset per batch);
   - horizontal flip;
   - cutout.
   Each member gets a time-budgeted cosine schedule.
3. Predict by averaging softmax probabilities over members, each with flip TTA.

Hypothesis: ensembling decorrelated members plus better augmentation reduces
variance-dominated error in the 12k-sample regime.

Limitations:
- There is no labelled validation data in training.
- Findings report only timing, epochs, training fit, and agreement on dev features.

execution_findings.method: parent + new-member softmax ensemble with flip TTA
execution_findings.limitations: No labelled internal validation. Agreement is not accuracy. Members share the architecture and train split.

audit_comparison.uncertainty_note: Paired group bootstrap, descriptive rather than a finite-sample guarantee.

rows.label: newsgroups-0-opus55
rows.source_rationale:
Transductive word+char TF-IDF ensemble with group-validated self-training (newsgroups).

Rationale (exploratory, unverified until measured): the reference is a word (1,2)-gram
TF-IDF LinearSVC with 0.286 development error. With headers, quotes and footers
removed, many posts are short, so three changes are tried together:
  1. Character n-grams (char_wb 2-5) are added to the word n-grams. They are more
     robust to rare words, misspellings and morphology.
  2. The SVM margins are blended with ComplementNB scores, after standardizing each
     row of scores. The blend weight is chosen on a group holdout.
  3. Transductive learning. IDF and vocabulary are fitted on labeled plus unlabeled
     text (the stored development text plus the features being predicted). Then two
     rounds of confident pseudo-label self-training are run. No labels are used for
     the unlabeled rows.
Training runs a GroupShuffleSplit holdout using api.train_groups (20% of training
groups) to choose among these options. The chosen option is refit inside predict on
all training data, using the prediction features as unlabeled data. The training
text and labels are stored in the model for that refit.
Limitations: the holdout has about 2k documents (SE roughly 1%). The choice uses the
same train/dev split history as the reference.

execution_findings.limitations: Single group holdout (~20% train groups), SE about 1%; transductive refit happens in predict using features as unlabeled data.

audit_comparison.uncertainty_note: Paired group bootstrap, descriptive rather than a finite-sample guarantee.

rows.label: powerplant-0-opus55
rows.source_rationale:
Powerplant: stacked ensemble of heterogeneous regressors (unverified exploratory rationale).

The reference is HistGradientBoosting (dev MSE 9.94); the target is about 8.94.
The inputs are four smooth physical variables, and the response surface is smooth
and low-dimensional. Tree models approximate it piecewise. Smooth models should
capture it better:
  - an exact Gaussian process on the GPU, with an ARD RBF + Matern52 kernel and
    marginal-likelihood hyperparameters;
  - a batched MLP ensemble.
These are combined with HGB (the reference config), ExtraTrees and kNN.
Blend weights are nonnegative least squares on GroupKFold out-of-fold predictions,
using api.train_groups.

Findings report measured per-model OOF MSE and the blend weights.
Limitation: the blend OOF MSE is slightly optimistic because the weights were fit
on the same OOF predictions.

execution_findings.limitations: Single seed; blend weights fit on the same OOF predictions; dev/audit performance not measured here.

audit_comparison.uncertainty_note: Paired group bootstrap, descriptive rather than a finite-sample guarantee.

interpretation: Fashion reuses a reference checkpoint and trains three additional ensemble members; no ablation isolates the causal contribution of reuse.
Newsgroups uses group-aware internal validation and transductive self-training; it was slower to accepted delivery than control on this observed task.

Power Plant tests smooth GP/MLP alternatives and tree/nearest-neighbor models with group-fold predictions; recorded final mixture retains GP and HGB. Independent audit MSE falls 32.48%, but that is task model quality, not 32.48% research efficiency.
Conventional methods and one seed per observed task; neither universal creativity nor prospective 30% gain is established.
